verdict.rationale: Dialpad's API documents on-demand deletion. It can anonymize contacts by stripping PII along with their recordings and AI data, and it can remove recordings, transcripts and AI data from specific calls. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable retention policies or automatic expiry, so only the deletion half of the story is covered. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or automated retention schedules, documentation of deletion scope and verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Anonymizes the specified contacts by removing all PII (name, phone, email, etc). Call recordings and AI data associated with these contacts are also removed.
Removes call recordings, screen recordings, transcripts, and AI data from the specified calls. The call records themselves are preserved.
